"""
Project Title: RealNVP Normalizing Flow for Density Estimation (ai-ml-ds-RealNVPMix2025)
File Name: realnvp_normalizing_flow.py

Short Description:
Implements a RealNVP normalizing flow in pure Keras to learn an invertible transformation between
a simple base Gaussian and a complex 2D mixture-of-Gaussians target distribution.
Includes coupling layers, masking, log‑determinant tracking, training loop, and sampling/inference examples.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
DIM: int = 2                # type: int = data dimension
HIDDEN: int = 128           # type: int = MLP hidden size
NUM_COUPLING: int = 6       # type: int = number of coupling layers
BATCH_SIZE: int = 256       # type: int = training batch size
EPOCHS: int = 2000          # type: int = training epochs
LR: float = 1e-3            # type: float = learning rate
LOG_DIR: str = "./realnvp_logs"
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Create 2D mixture-of-Gaussians dataset
# ----------------------------
def sample_mog(batch: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Samples from a mixture of 4 Gaussians arranged in a square.
    Returns: (batch,2) array.
    """
    choices = np.random.randint(0,4,size=batch)
    means = np.array([[-2,-2],[-2,2],[2,-2],[2,2]],dtype="float32")
    std = 0.3
    samples = means[choices] + np.random.randn(batch,2).astype("float32")*std
    return samples

# ----------------------------
# 3. Coupling Layer
# ----------------------------
class RealNVPCoupling(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, mask, hidden_dim=HIDDEN):
        super().__init__()
        self.mask = tf.constant(mask.astype("float32"))
        self.s_net = tf.keras.Sequential([
            layers.Dense(hidden_dim, activation="relu"),
            layers.Dense(hidden_dim, activation="relu"),
            layers.Dense(DIM, activation="tanh")
        ])
        self.t_net = tf.keras.Sequential([
            layers.Dense(hidden_dim, activation="relu"),
            layers.Dense(hidden_dim, activation="relu"),
            layers.Dense(DIM, activation=None)
        ])
    def call(self, x, reverse=False):
        x_mask = x * self.mask
        s = self.s_net(x_mask) * (1 - self.mask)
        t = self.t_net(x_mask) * (1 - self.mask)
        if not reverse:
            y = x_mask + (1 - self.mask) * (x * tf.exp(s) + t)
            logdet = tf.reduce_sum(s, axis=1)
            return y, logdet
        else:
            y = x_mask + (1 - self.mask) * ((x - t) * tf.exp(-s))
            return y

# ----------------------------
# 4. Build RealNVP Model
# ----------------------------
masks = []
for i in range(NUM_COUPLING):
    mask = np.array([i % 2, (i+1) % 2],dtype="float32")
    masks.append(mask)

x_in = Input(shape=(DIM,), name="x_in")
x = x_in
logdet_total = tf.zeros_like(x_in[:,0])
coupling_layers = []
for mask in masks:
    layer = RealNVPCoupling(mask)
    coupling_layers.append(layer)
    x, ld = layer(x, reverse=False)
    logdet_total += ld
model = Model(x_in, [x, logdet_total], name="RealNVP_Flow")

# ----------------------------
# 5. Base Distribution (Standard Gaussian)
# ----------------------------
base = tfp.distributions.MultivariateNormalDiag(loc=tf.zeros(DIM), scale_diag=tf.ones(DIM))  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 6. Loss: Negative Log-Likelihood
# ----------------------------
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)

@tf.function
def train_step(x_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        y, logdet = model(x_batch, training=True)
        logp = base.log_prob(y) + logdet
        loss = -tf.reduce_mean(logp)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, model.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, model.trainable_variables))
    return loss

# ----------------------------
# 7. Training Loop
# ----------------------------
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    x_batch = sample_mog(BATCH_SIZE)
    loss = train_step(x_batch)
    if epoch % 200 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS}, NLL Loss: {loss:.4f}")

# ----------------------------
# 8. Example Use Cases & Expected Outputs
# ----------------------------
# Use Case 1: Density estimation on grid for visualization
xx, yy = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-4,4,200), np.linspace(-4,4,200))
grid = np.stack([xx.flatten(), yy.flatten()],axis=1).astype("float32")
y_grid, ld_grid = model(grid, training=False)
logp_grid = base.log_prob(y_grid) + ld_grid
plt.contourf(xx, yy, logp_grid.numpy().reshape(200,200), levels=50)
plt.title("Learned Log-Density")
plt.colorbar()
plt.savefig(os.path.join(LOG_DIR,"density.png"))
plt.clf()

# Use Case 2: Sampling from the flow
z = base.sample(1000)
# invert through flow
x_samples = z
for layer in reversed(coupling_layers):
    x_samples = layer(x_samples, reverse=True)
x_samples = x_samples.numpy()
plt.scatter(x_samples[:,0], x_samples[:,1], s=5, alpha=0.5)
plt.title("Samples from RealNVP")
plt.savefig(os.path.join(LOG_DIR,"samples.png"))
plt.clf()

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Normalizing Flows: invertible density estimation via coupling layers.
  • RealNVP Architecture: masking, scale-and-shift nets, log‑det jacobian.
  • Applications: generative modeling, anomaly detection, likelihood-based learning.
  • Keywords/Hashtags: #NormalizingFlows, #RealNVP, #DensityEstimation, #Keras, #GenerativeModels.
